subject: Integrations: RedShield + AssureFlow evidence onramp for SOC2
messages:
From: Nadia Ortiz <nadia.ortiz@redshieldsec.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: ops@redshieldsec.com
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + evidence exchange for SOC2 engagement

Hi Logan —

Thanks again for the intro on the call last week. RedShield will be doing a scoped SOC2 readiness engagement for one of our mutual customers and we want to streamline evidence handoff so the assessment runs smoothly and avoids repeated requests.

High-level ask: can Redwood offer an automated pull/push endpoint or short-lived SFTP drop that AssureFlow (our GRC partner) can access to retrieve logs, configuration screenshots, and artifact bundles? We want to avoid manual download/upload in the assessment window.

I've attached a draft scope (redshield-scope.pdf) that lists the artifact types and retention windows. Our assessor, Jordan, will also need an integration contact to speed up onboarding.

Cheers,
Nadia Ortiz
Director, Operations
RedShield Security
--
Attachment: redshield-scope.pdf (PDF, 190KB)
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference.com>
To: Nadia Ortiz <nadia.ortiz@redshieldsec.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.inference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 10:01:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + evidence exchange for SOC2 engagement

Thanks Nadia — looping in our security integrations lead (Priya) and partnerships (Camila). This is exactly the sort of workflow we want to make painless.

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP):
- Week 0 (this week): agree transport (API webhook vs SFTP) and auth model (mTLS token vs short-lived signed URL).
- Week 1: exchange API specs and minimal SOW; AssureFlow test account for RedShield to push a small sample bundle.
- Week 2: end-to-end test with a representative artifact set; finalize retention/cleanup policy.

Priya — can your team own the API pairing and security posture review? Camila — happy to coordinate partner commercial T&Cs if a connector fee is needed.

I attached a one-page SOW stub to speed contracting; we can iterate. Looking to schedule a 30-min tech sync with AssureFlow + RedShield early next week.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: redwood-sow-onramp-draft.docx (DOCX, 24KB)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.inference.com>
To: Nadia Ortiz <nadia.ortiz@redshieldsec.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 08:25:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + evidence exchange for SOC2 engagement

Nadia — thanks, quick technical follow-ups from our side: 

1) Transport: we prefer an authenticated SFTP drop (short-lived creds) for large artifact bundles and a secured webhook for metadata/notifications. Push vs pull: if RedShield can push to our SFTP, that reduces polling and audit noise; if AssureFlow prefers to pull, we can provide a time-limited signed URL per bundle.

2) Auth: mTLS is fine but heavier for partners. Short-lived S3-compatible presigned URLs (with IP allowlist) or SFTP accounts scoped to a single path are pragmatic. Which does RedShield already support?

3) Evidence format: we can accept ZIP bundles with an index.json manifest (fields: artifact_type, source, timestamp, sha256). If AssureFlow has a different manifest schema we'll map it in the connector.

Karthik — can you confirm how Redwood's evidence retention & access logs appear in AssureFlow once bridged? We need to show immutable access logs for auditors.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Security Integrations PM
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.inference.com>, Nadia Ortiz <nadia.ortiz@redshieldsec.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + evidence exchange for SOC2 engagement

Quick technical notes from infra: 

- We can accept both SFTP and presigned HTTPS upload. For SFTP we spin ephemeral users tied to a job id; we rotate keys after each bundle ingestion and log every session to our audit pipeline. Those logs can be exported to AssureFlow via a secured webhook or pushed as artifacts.
- Our index.json manifest is flexible; attaching an example manifest and AssureFlow API spec so you can validate mapping.

Questions for RedShield:
- Typical bundle sizes? If >5GB we should do multipart upload over HTTPS; SFTP will work but will take longer to ingest.
- Do you require inbound firewall allowlisting for egress to your infrastructure?

I've attached the API spec we mentioned (assureflow-api-specs.yaml) and a sample manifest. Let's capture answers in the tech sync so we can build the connector in parallel with contract.

--
Attachment: assureflow-api-specs.yaml (YAML, 8KB)
From: AssureFlow Integrations <integrations@assureflow.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference.com>, Nadia Ortiz <nadia.ortiz@redshieldsec.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 16:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + evidence exchange for SOC2 engagement

Hi all — thanks for the clear MAP. A few clarifications from AssureFlow: 

- We can pull from a presigned HTTPS URL or accept a pushed webhook that includes a manifest URL. For large bundles (>2GB) we prefer multipart presigned uploads.
- On auditability: we will create an immutable artifact record (audit_trail) in our system once the bundle is validated — we surface that to assessors via our read-only reviewer account.
- For the tech sync: our integrations engineer, Mateo, can join Wednesday 10am PT. We'll test with a 100MB sample bundle first and validate the index schema.

Next steps (action owners):
- RedShield: confirm preferred transport and sample bundle by Wed EOD.
- Redwood (Priya/Karthik): provide ephemeral SFTP creds or presigned URL template and run a validation flow.
- Partnerships (Logan/Camila): finalize SOW and calendar invite.

Looking forward to the sync — attaching an integration checklist and test manifest.

Best,
AssureFlow Integrations Team
--
